models.mechanism: The exertion model is revised by the first explicit moral proposition. The panting racers no longer only show force concentrated into a center; they become an oath-image of total expenditure and directed completion set against the human who is cut off in gratitude toward the Lord who owns and nurtures him. The focus breath becomes a sign of responsiveness: bodies spend themselves to complete their arc, while the human fails in relational return.

structural_cues: 100:6 breaks the oath sequence with إن, turning the prior vivid actions into evidence for a moral claim.
The focus panting is now read backward from the predicate كنود: expenditure in the oath contrasts with withheld gratitude in the human.
لربه gives the relational direction that stage 4's concentrated arrival lacked: the issue is motion or response toward one's Lord.
ج م ع/B010 already supplied gathered force; ك ن د/B002 now supplies the opposite moral pattern, withholding and forgetting.

abductive_moves.assumption: The oath-scene is meant to function contrastively: nonhuman or martial force completes its directed expenditure, while the human fails to reciprocate Lordly nurture.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies the oath sequence and the moral assertion, but not the exact logical relation between the racers and human ingratitude.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: panting runners completing a force-sequence and the human being ungrateful to his Lord; inferred arrow: the completed expenditure of the first scene exposes the incomplete or withheld return of the human.
alternatives: The oath-scene could be illustrative intensity rather than contrast.
The runners could model human aggressiveness directly rather than stand as a counterexample to human ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: At stage 4, the focus read as bodily pressure gathered and aimed into the middle of a collected body.
changed_reading.after: After 100:6, the focus also reads as an oath-image of spent, directed responsiveness used to expose the human's failure of return to the Lord who owns and nurtures him.

minimal_triggers: إن shift from oath sequence to moral proposition
models.ablation: Removing 100:6 ك ن د/B002 or ر ب ب/B002 leaves the stage-4 force-concentration model but removes the contrast with withheld gratitude toward nurturing lordship. Removing ض ب ح/B001 leaves the moral claim intact but loses the focus-specific audible sign of total expenditure.

models.mechanism: The incursion model is moralized. The panting raid into the center of a gathered body now anticipates a deeper relation of breach: the human is severed and ungrateful toward his Lord. The focus root's dormant overstepping branch is therefore activated not only as battlefield penetration but as a pattern of crossing out of rightful dependence, cutting the bond of gratitude and covenant.

structural_cues: The move from 100:1-5 to 100:6 creates a structural turn from external incursion to internal moral judgment.
The preposition ل in لربه gives the violated relation a direction: the human's kanud-state is specifically toward his Lord.
ع د و/B001 and ك ن د/B001 converge on boundary failure: one crosses a limit, the other cuts a bond.
ر ب ب/B011 adds covenantal or protective-bond imagery that makes cutting gratitude more than a mood.

abductive_moves.assumption: The raid image can be transposed into the human-Lord relation as an image of breach rather than merely physical warfare.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies the oath scene and then moral predicate, but it does not state that the physical incursion symbolizes spiritual severance.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: overstepping runners and a human described as severingly ungrateful to his Lord; inferred arrow: the earlier incursion becomes the outward analogue of an inward breach of lordship and covenant.
alternatives: The raid may simply serve as an oath object without modeling the moral predicate.
The human's ingratitude may contrast with the scene rather than continue its aggressive motion.

changed_reading.before: At stage 4, the focus began a raid with a precise endpoint in the center of an assembled body.
changed_reading.after: After 100:6, the focus begins a moralized breach: the panting overstep foreshadows the human's severed gratitude toward the Lord who owns and protects him.

Removing ر ب ب/B001 and B011 removes the rightful relation that makes the overstepping morally legible. Removing ع د و/B001 leaves ingratitude but not a focus-root mechanism of crossing a bound.

models.mechanism: The material upheaval model is revised into a figure of barren nonproductivity. The focus had already activated hard ground, spark, ash, dust, and airborne residue; 100:6 adds that the human is kanud, whose inventory includes barren land that produces nothing. The panting rush over resistant ground now reads as a scene of extracting dust and sparks from dryness, set beside a human who receives lordly nurture yet yields no grateful fruit.

The oath-to-إن shift lets the physical dust scene be read as evidentiary preparation for a human condition.

abductive_moves.assumption: The dust and ash field can prefigure the human's moral barrenness because ك ن د links ingratitude with nonproductive land.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies dust, ash, nurture, and barren-land branches, but not the claim that the oath-scene is an agricultural or productivity analogy.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: dry ground and raised dust, lordly nurture, human kanud as barren and ungrateful; inferred arrow: failure to return gratitude is like ground under force that yields dust rather than growth.
alternatives: The barren-land branch of ك ن د may be metaphorically inactive here.
The dust may remain tactical cover rather than a moral figure.

changed_reading.before: At stage 4, the focus began an atmospheric penetration through spark and dust.
changed_reading.after: After 100:6, the focus can begin a barren-residue analogy: intense motion over dry resistance yields dust and ash, just as the human under nurture yields ingratitude rather than grateful fruit.

models.ablation: Removing 100:6 ك ن د/B003 leaves the dust mechanism but removes the barren-land moral revision. Removing ر ب ب/B002 removes the expected nurture that makes nonproductivity culpable. Removing ض ب ح/B005 weakens the focus-root bridge from panting/scorch to sterile residue.

models.mechanism: The moral-middle ambiguity is revised rather than resolved into simple approval or condemnation of the raid. 100:6 relocates the moral center from spatial وسط to relation: the decisive question is not merely whether entry into the middle is just, but whether the visible human stands rightly toward his Lord. The panting drive to a center now exposes a contrast between spatial centrality and relational severance.

abductive_moves.assumption: The spatial center of 100:5 and the Lord-directed moral relation of 100:6 should be read against each other.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies adjacency and branch inventories, but not a stated contrast between spatial center and relational center.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: entry into the middle, then human ingratitude to his Lord; inferred arrow: the achieved outer center reveals or contrasts with an inner severance from rightful authority.
alternatives: 100:6 may simply state the conclusion of the oath without revising the middle model.

changed_reading.before: At stage 4, the focus could initiate a morally ambiguous drive toward a spatial middle: overstepping or a forceful claim to the center.
changed_reading.after: After 100:6, that ambiguity is relocated: the focus drive toward a center now contrasts with a human who, despite perception and central presence, is relationally severed from his Lord.

models.ablation: Removing 100:6 removes the relational center and leaves only the stage-4 spatial ambiguity. Removing و س ط/B001 leaves the human-Lord moral claim but no contrast with the earlier just-middle branch. Removing ع د و/B001 removes the focus-root moral tension.

surprise_reading: With 100:6 revealed, the panting racers become more than kinetic spectacle. One reading sees their total exertion as a contrast to the human who withholds grateful return to the nurturing Lord. Another moralizes the raid as a figure of severed covenant and overstepping. A third revises the dust and ash field into barren nonproductivity: force over dry ground yields residue, as the human yields ingratitude rather than fruit. A fourth shifts the prior middle-ambiguity from spatial center to relational severance from the Lord.
